description: This file defines a Flutter ChangeNotifier class 'BooksProvider' responsible for managing the state of a list of books, including loading books from a service based on a search query.

classes.name: BooksProvider
classes.description: A provider class extending ChangeNotifier that manages the list of books, loading state, and current search query.

methods.name: loadBooks
methods.description: Asynchronously loads books based on the provided search query, updates the list of books, and manages loading state with notifications.
